title: References inbox + detail curation (accept/reject/archive)
description:
Was PPY-3aa283. Shadcn mobile-app newsroom: references list/filters by curation status, detail, accept/reject/archive via GraphQL reviewReferenceCuration. Demo + live. Pilobolus tenant. Composer 2.5.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

A rejected item cannot count as accepted positive priming. Existing draft/source is unfinished until integration, dependency release/pins and hosted scope checks pass.
